description:
Designer & management software for xTool laser cutters & engravers.


General
1. Redesigned Home Page: Search projects, generators, and Hubs by keyword or image. Use Atomm AI to generate designs for engraving, cutting, or printing, or 3D structures for laser cutting and assembly.
2. Improved Onboarding: A complete guided experience from app launch to the first project. (Currently available only for first-time users of M2, O1, and X1.)

Editor
1. Improved Box Selection: Drag left to right to select fully enclosed objects, or right to left to select all objects touching the selection box.
2. Enhanced Import: Import multiple files at once, including HEIC photos, and preserve original fills in DXF files.
3. Batch Resizing: Resize multiple selected objects at once.
4. Improved Coordinates & Scaling: Switch the coordinate origin and hold Option/Alt to scale from the center.
5. Improved Sidebar: Expand the sidebar to full screen for easier asset browsing and editing.
6. Improved Smart Nesting: Added Auto Fill, photo-based nesting across multiple sheets, manually defined nesting and exclusion areas, and shared-edge merging.
7. Improved Embossment Mode: Supports 16-bit depth maps, up to 1,024 layers, and a new Cleaning Layer.
8. Improved Image Engraving: Added Passthrough Mode.

Material Settings
1. Community Material Sharing: Explore materials shared by other users and apply materials and processing settings in one click.
2. Improved Material Grid Test: Added "Other Constant Parameters" to view and edit fixed settings beyond the row and column variables.
3. Home Page Material Settings: Create materials and save multiple processing presets from the Home Page without connecting a device.

Devices
1. Capture & Trace (M2, P3, P2S, P2): Capture and recognize designs, then automatically extract outlines for cutting.
2. Lenticular Card Mode (O1 Omni Printer): Automatically scan and detect card position, dimensions, and LPI, with no test patterns or manual alignment required.
3. Inner Engraving Presets: Select official glass presets to automatically load dimensions and quickly configure the refractive index and processing position.
4. Inner Engraving Focus Compensation: Compensate for focus height variations when engraving large glass surfaces.
5. White Ink Choke (Apparel Printer / Plus, Omni Printer): Adjust white ink choke size for individual objects.
6. Mockup Enhancement: Create custom mockup templates.

Bug Fixes
1. Fixed some known issues.
